PrismJS 1.30.0 — core, C-like, Java, Markup (XML/HTML), Kotlin, Groovy,
Bash, PowerShell, YAML, and JSON.

Source: https://github.com/PrismJS/prism/tree/v1.30.0
License: MIT (see LICENSE in this directory).

These files are unmodified upstream minified components. They are loaded locally
with manual highlighting; no CDN, autoloader, worker, or network request is used.
Project language aliases, build-tool tokens, PowerShell parameters, and the small
Minecraft command grammar are defined separately in assets/syntax.js.
Color roles are defined in src/syntax-java.css and src/syntax-code.css.
